messages:
Priya S: Heads-up — PathFinder private deploy smoke tests surfaced three onboarding gaps we need to triage quickly: (1) audit logs not forwarding to our SIEM, (2) KMS alias mismatch causing key access errors, (3) IAM role for inference missing kms permissions. @Ethan_N @Marta_K @Samir_R can you take ownership?
Ethan N: On it. Initial look shows VPC peering routes not propagating to the edge route table. I'll run `aws ec2 describe-route-tables` and push a propagation fix. ETA ~45m.
Marta K: KMS note — customer created alias `alias/pathfinder-prod` but our onboarding expects `alias/redwood-pathfinder-prod`. That breaks our grant checks. @Liam (PathFinder) did you intend the pathfinder alias?
Liam (PathFinder): We created `alias/pathfinder-prod` yesterday from Ops. If you need `alias/redwood-pathfinder-prod` we can change, but what's the blast radius?
Marta K: Renaming will rotate grants and could interrupt short-term access. Simpler: we can add an alias mapping on our side to accept both names, but that needs KMS admin approval. @Samir R can you approve a temporary mapping/grant?
Samir R: I can approve. Send the principal and key ARN. Also our IAM check flagged `pathfinder-infer-role` missing `kms:Decrypt` (and Encrypt for write ops). Paste the role policy if you can.
Priya S: Paste from smoke run: `AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:sts::1234567890:assumed-role/pathfinder-infer-role is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:1234567890:key/abcd-ef01-2345-6789`
Ethan N: Network fix deployed — route table propagation for peering completed and connectivity verified from customer bastion: `telnet 10.2.5.10 443` succeeds. :white_check_mark:
Liam (PathFinder): Confirmed connectivity from our side as well. Thanks @Ethan_N
Marta K: KMS mapping approved by Samir via DM. I'll apply a temporary grant for `pathfinder-infer-role` to allow `kms:Decrypt` on key `abcd-ef01`. I'll document expiry and rotation plan. ETA ~2h.
Priya S: Audit logs — their CloudTrail for the private deploy isn't forwarding to our forwarder. The SNS subscription ARN configured is `arn:aws:sns:us-west-2:1234567890:pf-audit-topic` but topic policy blocks cross-account subscriptions from `123456789012` (our forwarder). @Liam (PathFinder) can you add our account ID to the topic policy or we can wire a cross-account role?
Liam (PathFinder): I can add the account to the topic policy now. Will ping once done.
OnboardBot: Smoke test status update: connectivity=OK, temporary KMS grant applied (pending rotation), audit-forwarding=blocked by topic policy. Next automated check in 3h. Use `/onboard status pathfinder` for details.
Samir R: One operational note — if KMS and audit/observability aren't in baseline before cutover, this account will be pulled into the pre-renewal remediation playbook. Priya, want me to draft the renewal risk blurb for the weekly health report?
Priya S: Yes please. Capture actions, owners, timelines and we'll share in the health update. I'll follow up with a short customer note once audit forwarding is confirmed.
